## 相机 Wi-Fi 连接

- 首次连接相机时，允许 macOS 的定位请求，Renamint 即可在蓝牙配对后查找并加入相机 Wi-Fi。用同一台 Mac 再次连接时可沿用已有授权。
- 定位权限不可用，或你选择手动连接时，Renamint 会直接显示相机的热点名称。在 Mac 的 Wi-Fi 菜单加入该网络，再点「已连接，继续」即可打开相机相册。
- 已用 DJI Osmo Action 6 实测首次授权、再次自动连接和断开后恢复原 Wi-Fi。

适用于运行 macOS 26 或更高版本的 Apple 芯片 Mac。退出 Renamint，打开 DMG，将 App 拖入「应用程序」完成更新。

## Camera Wi-Fi connections

- Allow location access when macOS first asks. After Bluetooth pairing, Renamint can find and join your camera’s Wi-Fi. You can reconnect using the permission you already granted.
- If location access is unavailable or you choose to connect manually, Renamint shows the camera’s network name immediately. Join that network in your Mac’s Wi-Fi menu, then choose “I’ve connected, continue” to open the camera library.
- Tested with a DJI Osmo Action 6, including first-time permission, automatic reconnection, and restoration of the previous Wi-Fi after disconnecting.

For Apple silicon Macs running macOS 26 or later. Quit Renamint, open the DMG, and drag the app into Applications to update.
